steps.name: Register Your Business to Pay State Taxes

learnPages.formBusinessContent:
In this step, you will be able to create your new business!

 This online application will allow you to:

 - Register your business name, and
- Form your business with the New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES) 

This form will take about 5-10 minutes to complete.

At the end of the process, you will get your Entity ID immediately after payment is received (sometimes referred to as "NJ Corporation Number," the Entity ID is a 10 digit number used to identify your corporate records.
